# Sharafdin Yusuf

> Sharafdin Yusuf is a self-taught researcher, engineer, and open-source builder whose work sits at the intersection of computing, language, mathematics, and AI. His main focus is Somali AI research through Goobo Labs.

## Pages

- [About](https://sharafdin.com/): Biography, core contributions, and research focus
- [Milicsi](https://milicsi.sharafdin.com/): Writing in Somali about technology, AI, programming, and science

## Somali language and AI infrastructure

- [Soplang](https://github.com/soplang/soplang): A programming language designed for Somali speakers
- [Somali Language Standard](https://github.com/goobolabs/somali-language-standard): An open, machine-readable standard for Somali orthography, grammar, terminology, and AI resources
- [SomNLP-Corpus](https://github.com/goobolabs/SomNLP-Corpus): An open Somali text corpus for NLP and LLM research

## Tools and other open source

- [hanticoin-go](https://github.com/sharafdin/hanticoin-go): Blockchain core for Hanticoin, a Proof-of-Stake Layer-1 for payments in Somalia
- [Memvid](https://github.com/memvid/memvid): A memory layer for AI agents
- [YoAuditor](https://github.com/sharafdin/yoauditor): An LLM-powered code auditor built in Rust
- More: [github.com/sharafdin](https://github.com/sharafdin)

## Teaching and writing

- Mentorship at [Goobo Labs](https://www.goobolabs.so): Python, data science, machine learning, and NLP for Somali learners and developers
- Previously mentor and director at [Dugsiiye](https://dugsiiye.com)
- Writing: [Milicsi](https://milicsi.sharafdin.com/)

## Research focus

Natural language processing, low-resource language models, machine learning, and the mathematical foundations behind modern AI. Long-term focus: helping build the foundations for Somali AI through open datasets, language standards, research, open-source tools, and education.
